assessment: Signs of overwatering stress detected in Monstera deliciosa: soft, droopy leaves with slight yellowing at tips. Soil appears consistently saturated. The plant is not yet showing root rot but is at risk if watering frequency is not adjusted.

actions.action: Allow soil to dry out completely before next watering. Insert a chopstick or moisture meter 3 inches deep to confirm dryness.
actions.label: Pause water

actions.action: Ensure the pot has adequate drainage holes. Remove any saucer that traps standing water beneath the pot.
actions.label: Fix drainage

actions.action: Increase air circulation around the plant by opening a nearby window or using a gentle fan to help the soil dry faster.
actions.label: Improve airflow
